description: This file appears to generate a web page displaying call signal logs, with embedded PHP, JavaScript, and HTML. It fetches log data via AJAX and renders it in a paginated table.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the page with specific parameters for 'Gateway > Connection > QoS'.

methods.name: ajax success callback
methods.description: Processes the results of the AJAX call, generating a table with call signal logs and enabling pagination if logs exceed 10 entries.
